title: RareEvent ClassificationKPI

stats.done_summary:
Successfully implemented and applied the Temporal Stability Index (TSI) to industrial control telemetry data. Key accomplishments:
1. Implemented TSI calculation according to specification with population standard deviations (ddof=0)
2. Calculated overall TSI = 0.9684 for 5,000-point series, indicating high temporal stability
3. Performed rolling window analysis revealing significant temporal variations (TSI: 0.13-0.91)
4. Generated 7 comprehensive visualizations saved in report/images/
5. Conducted anomaly detection identifying 0.54% of frames as low-stability regions
6. Produced publication-quality research report with methodology, results, and discussion
7. All code, results, and intermediate outputs saved in organized directory structure
Deliverables: code/tsi_analysis.py, outputs/tsi_results.txt, outputs/rolling_tsi.csv, report/report.md with 7 figures
